title: Initialize active cleanup planning ledger
decision: Use `pldg-20260613-001-cleanup-fable-audit` as the active v2 Bootstrap Planning Ledger for the `Part 1 Cleanup Fable Audit of Plans` conversation. The ledger is source/planning memory only and canonical Plans remain untouched until explicit compile.

title: Section A is the first cleanup tranche
decision: Treat Jared's Section A, `Features with conflicting canonical definitions (two "truths" coexist)`, as the first Part 1 cleanup/audit tranche. Split its items into later-compile fix intents when the canonical winner is clear and open questions when a product/canon choice is still required.

title: Event-store coordination canon beats file-backed message board canon
decision: For the agent coordination/message-board conflict, record the later compile intent as: event-store/child-run contract persistence is canonical; file-backed message boards, active-agent files, verification JSONs, and lazy verification directories are optional debug mirrors only where retained.

title: Run Graph commands should align to shared command/runtime contracts
decision: For the Run Graph command/recovery conflict, record the later compile intent as: align HITL argument shapes, recovery routing, cross-surface open commands, projection trust payloads, and scheduler ordering to UI_Command_Catalog, Contracts_V0, and runtime scheduler canon rather than graph-local drift.

title: Repair executionLimits by restoring one canonical anchor
decision: For the crew/subagent executionLimits conflict, record the later compile intent as: restore or create one authoritative `Subagent Configuration executionLimits` anchor and deduplicate the repeated crew-cap subsection while preserving the actual values.

title: Contracts account_switch_event supersedes stale no-account-switched claim
decision: For the Multi-Account/Run Graph stale claim, record the later compile intent as: if Contracts_V0 defines `account_switch_event`, consumers must not claim there is no durable account switch event family unless a newer owner decision supersedes it.

title: Node/package/seam graph is sole live orchestrator runtime canon
decision: Jared agreed that node/package/seam graph should be the sole live orchestrator runtime canon. `Phase`, `Task`, `Subtask`, `Iteration`, `tier_id`, `TierType`, and `Tiers` should be treated as retired or compatibility-only terminology rather than peer runtime canon.

title: Exact four-widget dashboard catalog is canonical
decision: Jared agreed that the exact four-widget named dashboard catalog should be canonical. The larger `widget.*` list should be treated as future/candidate/widget-library material unless a specific owner doc has promoted an item.

title: FinalGUISpec §7.4.4 19-tab Settings registry is canonical
decision: Jared agreed that FinalGUISpec §7.4.4's 19-tab Settings registry should be the current canonical Settings IA baseline. The legacy 8-tab Config should be retired, and `24 tabs across 5 groups` plus the §16.1 migration set should be treated as stale/migration residue unless source inspection proves they contain promoted tabs missing from §7.4.4.

title: remediation.resolved compatibility mapping
decision: Jared agreed to map legacy `remediation.resolved` values to the newer enum as follows: `success -> fixed`; `ceiling_exceeded -> replan_required`; `failed -> abandoned` only when the remediation attempt is terminal. Non-terminal or ambiguous legacy `failed` records require an explicit newer value instead of automatic mapping.

title: batch_webextract max concurrency is 10
decision: Jared selected `10` as the canonical maximum concurrency for `batch_webextract`. Later compile should retain default concurrency 3 and max URL count 10, and retire the conflicting max 5 line as stale unless source inspection reveals an owner-level provider safety override.

title: Section A cleanup compiled to Plans with governance seal pending
decision: Compile Section A cleanup decisions into live Plans owner docs and regenerate Plans/.plan_index outputs. Strict ledger canonical_plan_targets are limited to governance-covered owner docs (Contracts_V0 and orchestrator-subagent-integration); additional edited owner docs are recorded in compiled_plan_outputs and atom compile notes pending a separate governance seal/coverage refresh.
